purpose: Exact fixed certificate for W021 section C. No success rate or scaling inference.
order: N outer, r inner, exactly listed. Complete every case even if a baseline or earlier coordinate yields a factor. Independent binomial audit after each full N block.
candidate_inputs: N and fixed public r only; no factor labels supplied. Sharing labels from gcd(N,r). No seeds or random calls.
baseline_policy: Base-2 Fermat gcd once per N, separately accounted and shared across four rows. gcd(N,r) is charged in each row. All proper output factors pass independent N%d witness verification.
selector: Dense right-to-left binary polynomial powering modulo (N,X^r-1), raw coefficient gcds, then coefficient gcds after both subtractions at 0 and N mod r. Count r^2 actual multiply-adds per product even for zero coefficients. No final unused square.
independent_verifier: All binomial coefficients generated by exact integer multiplicative recurrence and then folded for all four r. No polynomial powering in verifier. Exact recurrence divisions are justified by the binomial identity; all arithmetic is charged. Corrected vectors follow the explicitly charged two endpoint subtractions.
retention: Prepopulate every case unstarted. Retain missing factors, failed comparisons, errors, caps, and pending independent audits. Any interrupted current arithmetic operation is unperformed when the cooperative cap fires; a hard asynchronous timeout can leave partial counters and must be reported as such. No replacement cases or rerun.
accounting: One convolution MAC includes a scalar multiply, add, modular reduction, and cyclic index calculation; it is a composite arithmetic event, not a bit operation. Scalar modular multiply similarly includes reduction. Charge every Euclidean remainder plus one gcd-call event. Charge each input decimal multiply-add, input validation, public r, setup cell, exponent loop bit, endpoint index/subtraction, verifier division test, integer binomial multiply/divide/decrement, binomial coefficient remainder, fold index and modular addition as named in code. Python loop/index/control, comparisons, allocations, serialization, hashing, source reads, OS start, and report writing are not arithmetic events. Max operand width is recorded at charged operations; intermediate products in MACs may be wider. No bit-complexity or fair wall-clock speed comparison is claimed.
pre_run_cost_bound: Dense convolution events = sum_N(bit_length(N)-1+popcount(N)) * (4+9+25+49), below 6000. Integer verifier recurrence/folding below 11200. Remaining baseline, gcd, input, correction and witness work is expected below 2800 for these tiny widths but is capped at runtime regardless; full retention applies if this conservative planning estimate is insufficient.
precommitted_interpretation: A proper coefficient gcd in a coprime-r case establishes only that fixed witness. Sharing controls are compared to gcd(N,r), never credited as extra factors. A miss disproves only a claimed guarantee for that row/menu. No particular outputs or count of splits is predicted. Report all vectors and costs; prove the r=2 and Frobenius-permutation identities symbolically regardless of outcomes.
